title: Randy Savage vs. Ricky Steamboat
summary: Savage’s attack on Steamboat’s throat turns an Intercontinental title rivalry into a revenge story. Steamboat returns to challenge him at WrestleMania III.

chapters.title: Savage injures Steamboat’s throat
chapters.result: Savage attacks Steamboat with the timekeeper’s bell after their match.
chapters.context: Television airdate. The storyline injury removes Steamboat from action and raises the stakes of his return.

chapters.title: Steamboat wins the Intercontinental title
chapters.context: The returning challenger wins the championship in the rivalry’s signature match.
